continue.description: Default true. false stops Claude entirely after the hook runs, and beats an event-specific decision. It does not by itself block a PreToolUse tool call.

stopReason.description: Shown to the user when continue is false. It stays in the conversation, so Claude sees it later.

systemMessage.description: A warning shown to the user, not added to Claude's context. Capped at 10,000 characters; longer text is saved to a file and replaced by its path and a 2,000 character preview.

terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

decision.description: Rejects the prompt. Omit it to let the prompt through.

reason.description: Shown to the user, not added to context.

additionalContext.description: Text added to Claude's context alongside the submitted prompt, wrapped in a system reminder and not shown as a chat message. State facts rather than give commands. Capped at 10,000 characters.

sessionTitle.description: Sets the session title, for naming a session from its prompt.

suppressOriginalPrompt.description: true leaves the prompt text out of the block message. The prompt can still appear in local transcript files.

title: UserPromptSubmit hook output
description: Adds context to a prompt or rejects it. Exit code 2 rejects it too, with stderr as the reason. Plain-text stdout is added to Claude's context.
